title: 2.3.11 A13.1 Asteroid Field
description: Combine Groups, overlap detection, and safe despawn into a playable asteroid scene. WASD steers the ship; an overlap with any asteroid ends the game.

steps.title: Set up the scene
steps.instructions: Create a canvas, a player ship sprite, and an asteroids Group. Pick any visual style.
hints: The Groups docs chapter (right drawer → Docs tab) covers Group creation and defaults.

steps.title: WASD steering
steps.instructions: In draw(), read kb.pressing('a' / 'd' / 'w' / 's') and set the ship's vel accordingly. Else-to-zero so the ship doesn't drift.
hints: Open the Input docs chapter for the kb API. Don't use arrow keys — they scroll the editor.

steps.title: Spawn at least 10 asteroids with varied velocity
steps.instructions: Either spawn a batch in setup() with a for loop, or drip-spawn in draw() using frameCount % N === 0. Each asteroid gets its own vel.x / vel.y.
hints: Math.random() * range gives you variety. The Apple Catcher example (2.3.7) shows the timed-spawn idiom.

steps.title: Overlap-driven hit state
steps.instructions: Use ship.overlaps(asteroids, callback) or the boolean form to detect a hit. On hit, transition to a 'hit' state — change background, log a message, or stop updating.
hints: The Collisions docs chapter covers the boolean and callback forms of overlaps().

steps.title: Safe despawn for off-screen asteroids
steps.instructions: If asteroids leave the canvas, remove them. Iterate backwards or iterate a copy ([...asteroids]) to avoid the iterate-then-remove bug.
hints: The Safe Despawn worked example (2.3.10) demonstrates both safe patterns.

requirements.title: Asteroid Group exists
requirements.description: Create at least one Group with new Group()

requirements.title: Asteroids have velocity
requirements.description: Assign to .vel.x or .vel.y on a sprite

requirements.title: WASD ship input
requirements.description: Use kb.pressing with one of 'a', 'd', 'w', 's' inside draw()

requirements.title: Safe despawn loop
requirements.description: Iterate backwards (i = length - 1) OR iterate a copy ([...group] via for…of, .forEach, .map, etc.)
